svg.title: Toolkit
svg.desc: AI and ML: Python, scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, LLM APIs, R. Data engineering: Spark, Kafka, Databricks, Delta Lake, Avro, SQL. Cloud and tooling: AWS, Confluent Cloud, Docker, Git. Analytics and BI: Power BI, Tableau, Matplotlib, Excel. Business systems: SAP, TM1, Salesforce. Credentials: Databricks Fundamentals / AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials.
